subject.title: build(deps): bump the android-deps group across 1 directory with 2 updates

question: Should the Android area owner accept the Kotlin 2.4.10 compiler, Compose, and serialization plugin upgrade once the Android validation lanes complete on the rebased head?
rationale: A shared Kotlin catalog version affects Android compilation and Compose behavior; CI can demonstrate compatibility, but accepting the upgrade cadence is an owner judgment.

options.title: Accept after Android validation
options.body: Merge after the Android build, test, and lint checks pass on the exact rebased head.

options.title: Hold at Kotlin 2.4.0
options.body: Close or defer the update if Android compatibility policy requires a separately planned compiler upgrade.

recommendation.title: Accept after Android validation
recommendation.body: Merge after the Android build, test, and lint checks pass on the exact rebased head.

likelyOwner.reason: No reliable Android-area ownership provenance could be read in this restricted review environment.
